description:
Update field association item parameters in field association schemes.

**Request body limits:** a single request can update parameters for at most **100 fields** (the top-level field ID keys of the request body). In addition, each field may include at most 50 update items, and each update item may reference at most 50 field schemes. Exceeding any of these limits returns a 400 response with an error such as "The fieldIds must contain no more than 100 items."

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

requestBody.description: The request containing the field association scheme id and the parameters to update.

200.description: Returned if the field parameter update was successful.

204.description: The request completed successfully. No additional content will be sent in the response.

207.description: Returned if the field parameter update was partially successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid. If request is malformed, returns a collection of errors. If request is well-formed but contains invalid scheme or field IDs, returns failure details. Also returned if the request body exceeds its limits (for example, more than 100 fields), with an error such as "The fieldIds must contain no more than 100 items."

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions
